summary: Checked all 9 non-infra repos. 8 were clean: zero open PRs, green CI, nothing to merge or fix. btc-llm-sentiment's 5 dependabot PRs were closed by the owner directly (not by this run); its default-branch CI stays red on the already-diagnosed unresolvable shap/numpy/tensorflow-cpu dependency graph, which needs a coordinated re-pin outside this job's scope. kinz-secure-commerce-hub confirmed PR #73's PyJWT fix is live and pip-audit is green, but one genuinely unpatched upstream Trivy/OS CVE keeps main red (unfixable from this sandbox, no apt network access); also confirmed this session's comment-posting path structurally mangles '@dependabot rebase' into garbled text, blocking the dependabot-rebase workflow in that repo (PRs #37/#64 stay conflicted) -- an infra issue for the owner, not a code fix.
